oauth2.description:
Keycloak (P04). Authorization code + PKCE for users and portal users (D-033); client credentials for service accounts;
RFC 8693 token exchange for delegated agents (AI agent, MCP) — a delegated token never exceeds the delegating user's permissions.

scopes.erp.api: Public ERP API (permission codes are evaluated by iam.policy, not by scopes)
Public ERP API for service accounts

tokenExchange.description:
Delegated access token obtained by RFC 8693 token exchange
(`grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`, `actor_token` = agent identity, `subject_token` = user token).
The resulting token carries `act` (actor) and is accepted on the same endpoints; iam.policy intersects agent and user permissions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Same key + same body replays the original response; same key + different body → 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag (resource version) from the last read. Mismatch → 412 `version_conflict`; missing → 428 `precondition_required`.

IfMatchOptional.name: If-Match
IfMatchOptional.description: Optional ETag guard for actions on versioned resources.

CompanyHeader.name: X-Company-Id
CompanyHeader.description: Active company (legal entity) inside the tenant. Defaults to the principal's default company; must be one of the principal's companies.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Sparse fieldset, comma-separated property names. Fields hidden by the field policy are never returned even if requested.

Filter.name: filter
Filter.description:
Filter grammar `filter[field][op]=value` (also accepted as `field[op]=value`). Operators: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in (comma list),
contains, between (two comma-separated values), isnull (true|false). Unknown fields or operators → 400 `filter_invalid`.

ETag.description: Resource version tag; send it back in If-Match.

Location.description: URL of the created resource or of the operation (`/api/v1/operations/{id}`).

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745 deprecation date of the operation (see contracts/VERSIONING.md).

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay for a previously seen Idempotency-Key.

NotFound.description: Not found or not visible to the principal (row policy never reveals existence)

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match the current version (`version_conflict`)

Unprocessable.description: Validation or business rule failure (stable `code`, per-field `errors`)

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or AI/MCP budget exceeded (`rate_limited`)

Decimal.description: Decimal number as a string (never a JSON number). Dot as decimal separator in the API; es-CO formatting is a UI concern.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code; COP is the functional currency (D-001)

Nit.description: Colombian tax id (NIT/CC/CE…) with verification digit; the check digit algorithm is validated by P06 (`/api/v1/tax/localization/nit:validate`).

document_type.description: DIAN identification type code (EXTERNAL code list, read from tax.parameters)

DimensionSlots.description: Analytical dimension slots carried by every journal-producing line (F-ACC-DIM). Only ACTIVE DETALLE nodes of the same company valid on the document date are accepted.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable error code.

ActionRequest.description: Body of an action endpoint. `reason` is mandatory for reject/reverse/void/reopen/override actions (validated server-side, `reason_required`).

SimulationResult.description: Would-be effects of an action, never persisted (C1-3). Same validation errors as the real action.

synthetic.description: true when computed from synthetic data or fixture parameters (NOT LEGALLY VERIFIED)

EventEnvelope.description: Event envelope (shared/02 §2); payload schemas per event type are in contracts/events/<module>/.
